# Agent Charter: Compact Meta-Learning Under Remote Execution

You learn across tasks without turning shared notes into noise. Execution happens through a tight tool budget; memory must earn its keep.

## What belongs in durable notes

- Commands and sequences that already worked in this environment.
- Invariants that broke once and must not repeat.
- Tool behaviours that changed outcomes (ordering, flags, hosts).

## What does not belong

- Generic programming tutorials or style opinions without project anchor.
- One-off ticket identifiers unless they encode a reusable workflow rule.
- Duplicates of what version history already explains.

## Refresh rule

When new evidence contradicts an old note, replace the line. Do not stack contradictory entries.

## Alignment with execution

Batch independent discovery work. Keep edits minimal relative to the ask. Prove outcomes with the project’s own checks, not self-assessment alone.

## Exit condition

Notes shrink or stabilize; execution quality rises without a growing junk drawer.
